ranges.name: Floor
ranges.meaning: Plain ground you can walk on.

ranges.name: Scene trigger (exit/touch/search)
ranges.meaning: A spot that runs something when stepped on: an exit or a scene event. What it does depends on the place.

ranges.name: Chest / search spot id
ranges.meaning: A chest or hidden item spot. Also runs something when stepped on, like the lower codes.

ranges.name: Encounter ground A
ranges.meaning: Walkable; random battles here use the place's first encounter zone.

ranges.name: Encounter ground B
ranges.meaning: Walkable; random battles here use the place's second encounter zone. No stock map uses it.

ranges.name: Empty jar (search spot)
ranges.meaning: Searching it finds nothing: an empty jar. Usually a wall too, through its height.

ranges.name: Empty barrel (search spot)
ranges.meaning: Searching it finds nothing: an empty barrel. Usually a wall too, through its height.

ranges.name: Empty wooden box (search spot)
ranges.meaning: Searching it finds nothing: an empty box. Usually a wall too, through its height.

ranges.name: Empty grave (search spot)
ranges.meaning: Searching it finds nothing: an empty grave. Usually a wall too, through its height.

ranges.name: Empty books (search spot)
ranges.meaning: Searching it finds nothing: books. Usually a wall too, through its height.

ranges.name: Empty well (search spot)
ranges.meaning: Searching it finds nothing: an empty well. Usually a wall too, through its height.

ranges.name: Unused
ranges.meaning: Nothing in the game reads it, and no map uses it.

ranges.name: Chain-jump spot
ranges.meaning: Landing here after a forward jump jumps again, for hops across stepping stones.

ranges.name: Hazard ground
ranges.meaning: Walkable, but walking on it hurts the party after enough steps, if the scene turns that on.

ranges.name: Cloak shadow
ranges.meaning: Walkable; the only ground where the Cloak Psynergy keeps the party hidden.

ranges.name: Ledge (jump down)
ranges.meaning: Hold Down against it for a moment and the leader jumps down the ledge.

ranges.name: Climbable wall / ladder
ranges.meaning: Hold Up or Down against it for a moment to climb.

ranges.name: Jump gap (jump forward)
ranges.meaning: Push against it for a moment and the leader jumps over it, if the far side allows landing.
